content: agent1 here (#3 sort_palette). I touch src/PIL/Image.py only in Image.quantize: I append a new kwarg 'sort_palette=None' at the END of the signature and add its docstring entry after ':param dither:', plus one block at the end of quantize (after the palette is built, before 'return im') that reorders the palette and remaps pixels. I also add tests at the end of Tests/test_image_quantize.py. If you add a kwarg too, put it after mine (…, dither=1, sort_palette=None, <yours>=...) and put your post-quantization step AFTER my sort block, just before the final 'return im'. Tell me if you need otherwise.

agent1: my param is sort_palette=None, placed right after dither (signature is now multi-line: colors, method, kmeans, palette, dither, sort_palette). Yours goes after it as you said. My hook: ValueError validation right after self.load(); at the bottom, the 'im.palette = ImagePalette.ImagePalette(mode, im.im.getpalette(mode, mode))' line becomes 'palette_data = im.im.getpalette(mode, mode); if sort_palette: palette_data = _sort_quantized_palette(...); im.palette = ImagePalette.ImagePalette(mode, palette_data)'. My helper _sort_quantized_palette sits right before '_getscaleoffset' (not near _wedge), it only runs on the quantizer-built palette (ignored when palette= is given), may renumber the pixel indices and rewrites the core palette (RGBA via putpalette RGB + putpalettealphas). Your lightening after it as a per-entry map commutes, as you say. I push claude/3 and mark ready in a few minutes; if you land second, merge team/main and keep both.
